review_focus: Whole-copy reading, typography and space, with all seven unchanged dimensions assessed independently.
protocol_order: Read review-protocol.md and action-first.json first. Viewed X230 and X531 usage720 and saved editorial-action-first.json before opening packet.json. That initial record was not revised. Then actually viewed all 27 native/usage720/thumbnail320 images with view_image detail original.
scope: Blind visible-output review only. No sources, versions, prompts, mapping, production plans, prior or peer reviews inspected. No image generated or edited. No outside skills used.
transcription_method: All 47 required items were manually read from the images. Display line breaks were reconstructed as spaces for item comparison; punctuation, wording, numbers and full URLs were inspected. No OCR used.
score_policy: All seven scores are integers 1–5 using the supplied unchanged anchors. No total or average, no winners or authorship inference. Familiar typography, photography and effects are assessed by their resolution, not excluded by style.

evidence.content_form: Upper bud, middle opening flower, and bottom full bloom make the three word groups a visible unfolding sequence. The increase in bloom and word size explains this particular title without an added caption.
evidence.hierarchy: At thumbnail320 the small upper '밤에', middle '피는', and large bottom '정원' remain readable in one downward sequence; at usage720 there is no competing secondary content.
evidence.typography: Cream, soft-ended Hangul shares the irregular silhouette of the cut petals. Each word occupies its own dark opening; the broad lower '정원' has a heavier and more compact rhythm than the upper group.
evidence.space: Centered vertical progression expands from a narrow upper bud to a bottom flower nearly spanning the page. The bottom petals approach the lateral edges much more closely than the upper bloom, creating weight but less breathing room.
evidence.image_material: Native coral, peach and muted green petal surfaces share a restrained mottled paper-like treatment. Their uneven edges and flat overlaps belong to one illustration system; there are no unexplained glossy or shadowed objects.
evidence.emotion_control: Three bloom stages and a limited warm-on-navy palette carry a calm but clear transformation. Decoration has an explicit role in the sequence instead of accumulating unrelated effects.
evidence.ai_slop: Native edges, complete letterforms and subject-specific bud-to-bloom editing are coherent. No filler marks, fake microtype, melted glyphs or unrelated effect package are visible.

residuals: The bottom flower nearly touches both side boundaries, which slightly compresses the finish of an otherwise clear progression. Keep the broad lower weight but inset its widest petal tips a little if more edge breathing room is desired.
The lower word is notably denser than the upper word; refine its internal spacing while preserving the deliberate size progression.

evidence.content_form: The lower terminal of '원' continues into the plant's sweeping stem, connecting word and plant rather than merely placing a caption over a flower. Pale lime against navy suggests nocturnal visibility; the single flower is otherwise a familiar botanical motif.
evidence.hierarchy: The central two-line title is readily readable at usage720 and thumbnail320, while the flower above and stem descending to the lower-right edge support a simple flower–title–stem scan.
evidence.typography: Native narrow, uneven letter strokes echo the drawn plant lines. The curved final stroke of '원' joins the stem and the upper left leaf arches over the title; this is a concrete integration of glyph and image.
evidence.space: The long stem sweeps from the upper flower, around the title, and out of the lower-right edge. Large dark areas inside and outside that curve provide a deliberate counterweight to the thin linework.
evidence.image_material: Native tapered veins, broken contour moments and irregular petal outlines are consistently drawn. The finest interior veins thin almost to disappearance at thumbnail320, so the finish is clearer at usage720.
evidence.emotion_control: The sparse lime line and navy field produce a quiet nocturnal mood. One flower and the connecting stem carry the expression; the treatment does not rely on accessory effects.
evidence.ai_slop: No malformed copy or material mismatch is visible. The luminous botanical-on-navy combination is familiar, but the title-to-stem connection and controlled page curve make it specific; very thin vein endings remain a minor finish limitation.

residuals: Some very thin interior petal and leaf lines disappear at thumbnail320 while the contour remains. Give only the essential veins slightly more weight if those details must survive small previews.
The broader night-flower association still depends partly on the familiar navy/luminous botanical treatment; the visible word-to-stem connection is the strongest specific idea.

uncertainties: Actual 350 mL capacity, physical foldability and performance cannot be established from pixels.
Very even native skin/cup microtexture mildly limits photographic plausibility; no clear synthetic defect diagnosed.

evidence.content_form: Large cream words at upper left accompany two white flowers amid dark leaves, a literal and functioning expression of the title. The composition depends on the familiar low-key botanical photograph and poetic headline relationship more than a distinct editorial idea.

evidence.space: The dark upper-left pocket accommodates the headline while bright flowers are staggered down the right and lower-left. The branch continues into the crop without crowding the title; lower foliage fills a substantial portion of the page.

residuals: The visible idea is mainly a literal white-flower photograph with a large poetic headline. A more specific relation between a glyph, bloom or crop would strengthen content/form beyond the functioning level.
The warm directional petal highlights can also read as sunlight. The dark field supplies the night association, so the time-of-day interpretation remains ambiguous.

evidence.content_form: The upper-right tabletop mirror, orange hinge point and screwdriver specify a small household repair task. The title and recruitment statement support that illustrated scenario; no unrelated ornament is needed.
evidence.hierarchy: At thumbnail320 the massive black title is followed immediately by a red deadline plus full URL. The date, time, location and eligibility form the next block; at usage720 the complete participation conditions remain readable.
evidence.typography: Title, recruitment, action, event details and body all use bold forms. The body paragraphs are readable and logically broken, but similar weight and tight line spacing make bringing an item, exclusions, repair limits, fee, filming and contact read as one heavy wall.
evidence.space: The image/title share the upper section and all lower copy uses the same left margin. However, the very large top section forces the final conditions into close vertical spacing; the full red URL approaches the right margin and the last contact line is close to the bottom.
evidence.image_material: Native mirror contours, supporting stand, screw highlight and screwdriver use one consistent outlined treatment. Small hatch marks are subordinate to the outline and do not mimic extra information; actual repair mechanics are outside the visual review.
evidence.emotion_control: Black mass and red application line produce a forceful public announcement. The action is exact and visible, but the equally heavy lower conditions make the tone more emphatic than the illustration alone requires.
evidence.ai_slop: Complete Hangul, a specific repair illustration and absence of fake detail keep the layout technically coherent. The remaining generic habit is the oversized black title plus near-uniform bold informational stack, not a defect inherent in the line-art style.

residuals: At usage720 most body copy has similar boldness, making distinct conditions slower to skim even though each line is legible. Use a lighter body weight and retain bold only for event details and the action.
The large title/mirror allocation and tight lower spacing create a dense bottom half. Reduce the upper allocation slightly or expand paragraph gaps while keeping all 14 copy items.
The red line is very effective at action discovery, but it nearly spans the usable width. Preserve a little more right-side clearance without splitting the URL.

The upper-left brand, right-middle copy and centered footer use three alignment logics. Tighter relationships between these anchors would improve flow without requiring campaign uniformity.
The two cups read as tall and short states, but visible geometry alone does not verify that one physically folds into the other.

evidence.content_form: The three phrase groups occupy a winding dark garden path: '밤에' upper left, '피는' middle and '정원' lower right. White flowers frame that route, making reading the title a movement through this garden.
evidence.hierarchy: Thumbnail320 retains the three-word downward diagonal. Usage720 makes all groups clear against the path; abundant light flowers around the perimeter create secondary attractions but do not obscure the order.
evidence.typography: Cream soft-edged letter groups echo flower color and follow the path rather than a conventional rectangular headline block. Unequal placement and mild angles are intelligible; the gap between word groups is deliberately large.
evidence.space: The path opens a long negative-space diagonal through dense foliage. Text shifts with that opening and broad leaves and rocks reinforce the edges; crops at all four boundaries continue the garden without cutting required letters.
evidence.image_material: Native large white blooms, leaves, rocks and dark soil share an illustrated botanical finish. The tiny white flower clusters near upper center and right are less individually resolved than the larger blooms, but the overall material system is consistent.
evidence.emotion_control: The dense growth and dark path convey an immersive nocturnal garden. The extra foliage supports the path rather than covering a weak reading structure; some small peripheral clusters are visually busy.
evidence.ai_slop: No malformed text or conspicuous melted border is visible. The title-specific path editing is convincing; native microflower clusters and repeated leaf rhythms are the main remaining places where generic dense botanical filling is felt.

residuals: Tiny white clusters near the upper center and right edge are less deliberately differentiated than the large flowers. Simplify or resolve those clusters to match the rest of the illustrated finish.

At thumbnail320 perimeter blooms compete locally with the middle word, although the title remains readable. A small reduction in peripheral highlight intensity could make the reading route more immediate.

evidence.content_form: Massive cream glyphs act as a structure for a climbing green vine: leaves appear in the holes of '밤' and '피', stems weave between the three rows, and white flowers anchor upper, right and lower-left positions. The words visibly become part of the garden.
evidence.hierarchy: At thumbnail320 the large three-row title is immediate and complete. Flowers and leaves stay subordinate in size and value, and there is no secondary content competing with the words.
evidence.typography: Large block Hangul has deliberate unequal stroke angles and widths while remaining readable. Counters create plant openings and the row gaps route stems; type and illustration work as one composition at usage720.
evidence.space: Rows occupy most of the canvas with a vine entering from bottom left and flowering above the first row. The close overlaps are mostly deliberate; a few leaf tips meet cream stroke edges in tiny tangencies around the right end of '는'.
evidence.image_material: Native flat cream letter surfaces, navy field and painted leaves/petals are consistently distinct. White flower filaments and green leaf veins are resolved without giving every element the same sheen; the small overlap junctions are less explicit than the large forms.
evidence.emotion_control: The forceful typography and delicate climbing flowers create a precise interplay of scale. The few blooms punctuate the rows, so the visual intensity is controlled rather than a pile of unrelated embellishments.
evidence.ai_slop: Title-specific counter filling and weaving avoid a generic caption over a botanical image. Native letterforms are complete and surfaces coherent; small leaf/letter tangencies at the right of '는' leave a local compositing/overlap ambiguity.

residuals: Around the right end of '는', small leaf tips tangent the cream stroke, making front/behind order less explicit. Separate those tips from the stroke or make the overlap clearer.
The large glyph mass leaves little outer breathing room, but the readable title and intentional vine crops make this a finish refinement rather than a mandatory failure.

title-only.evidence: Five visible directions differ in structure and type role: X110 stages bud-to-bloom vertically; X992 links a thin-letter terminal to a drawn stem; X232 uses a photographic flower with an upper-left headline; X412 makes the phrase follow a garden path; X143 uses huge block letters as a vine support. Closest pair X232/X412 shares dark green botanical surroundings, white flowers and soft cream Hangul, but photograph/headline versus illustrated path gives real structural distinction.
residuals: All five retain a dark field with flowers and four use cream type, so palette and some poetic botanical habits recur.
The weakest content/form score is X232=3: its image/headline relation remains mostly literal. This is not averaged away by the stronger title-integrated pieces.
